source.title: Ulster Herald, 9 May 1936, p. 5 ("Nominations in Tyrone: the Omagh gerrymander")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the eleven divisions and names read from the Ulster Herald's Tyrone nominations report (9 May 1936, p. 5)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 5 May 1936. Eleven divisions were filled unopposed; no nominations were received in Errigal, Fivemiletown, Foremass and Newtownsaville, whose retiring members held their seats, and Cullamore was contested between the sitting member, Mr. James E. Hackett, and a second candidate. Only the eleven unopposed returns are recorded here. Filed on 1936-06-03, the Tyrone polling day (previously filed under 1936-05-28, 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
